segments.text: UPSC just changed the rules for civil services. Subscribe full disclosure and I'll quickly break down what actually changed in this notification. 2026
notification introduces strict restrictions on who can reappear for the exam after getting selected. First, if an aspirant is already serving in IAS or
IFS, she is not allowed to appear in CSE 2026. Practically to compete again in future, she has to resign and still satisfy age and attempt limits. Second,
for IPS officers, they can still write the exam again, but from cse 2026 onward, IPS is locked and the selected
person can't opt for or be allotted IPS again. Third, for group A service allotties, if they get IPS or another
group A service via CSE 2026, they'll get one special chance to reappear in cse 2027 with a one-time exemption from
training. But from cse 2028 onwards, no more attempts unless you resign from your allocated service. Are these rules
necessary to stop candidates from endlessly reattempting while blocking new aspirants? What are your thoughts on this? Comment below.
